title: A message from Lucy
situation_ru: Подруга оставляет голосовое сообщение и приглашает в пиццерию.
script: Lucy: Hi Tom, it's Lucy. [pause 1s] Are you free on Saturday? There's a new pizza place in the city centre. It's called Luigi's, and it's on Green Street, next to the cinema. The pizza is really good, and it isn't expensive. Let's meet there at half past seven. My sister is coming too. She really wants to meet you. [pause 1s] Oh, and I'm paying, because you helped me with my flat last week! Call me back, OK? Bye!

questions.q: Where is the pizza place?
questions.explain_ru: Пиццерия на Green Street, рядом с кинотеатром.

questions.q: What time are they meeting?
questions.explain_ru: Let's meet there at half past seven — в 19:30.

questions.q: Why is Lucy paying?
options: Tom has no money this week
questions.explain_ru: Том помог ей с квартирой на прошлой неделе.

situation_en: Your friend Lucy leaves you a voice message. She invites you to a pizza place.

title: At the café
situation_ru: Посетитель заказывает еду и кофе в кафе.
script:
Waiter: Hi there! What can I get you?
Customer: Hi. Can I have a large coffee with milk, please?
Waiter: Sure. Anything to eat?
Customer: Do you have any sandwiches?
Waiter: Yes, we have cheese, chicken or egg.
Customer: Chicken, please. Oh, and a bottle of water.
Waiter: OK. Is that to go, or are you staying here?
Customer: Here, please. By the window.
Waiter: Great. That's nine dollars fifty.
Customer: Can I pay by card?
Waiter: Of course.

questions.q: What sandwich does the customer order?
questions.explain_ru: Посетительница выбирает сэндвич с курицей.

questions.q: How much does she pay?
questions.explain_ru: That's nine dollars fifty — 9,50 доллара.

questions.q: Where is she going to have her food?
questions.explain_ru: Она остаётся в кафе и садится у окна.

situation_en: A customer orders food and coffee in a café.

title: A train announcement
situation_ru: Объявление на вокзале о поезде в Брайтон.
script: Announcer: Good morning. This is an announcement for passengers travelling to Brighton. [pause 1s] The ten fifteen train to Brighton is ten minutes late. It will now leave at ten twenty-five from platform four. [pause 1s] I repeat: the train to Brighton will now leave at ten twenty-five from platform four. Passengers for London, your train is on time and leaves from platform one. There is a café on platform two. We are sorry for the delay.

questions.q: How late is the train to Brighton?
questions.explain_ru: The train is ten minutes late — поезд опаздывает на 10 минут.

questions.q: Which platform does the Brighton train leave from?
questions.explain_ru: Поезд отправляется с четвёртой платформы.

situation_en: You are at a train station. Listen to an announcement about a train to Brighton.

title: Plans for the weekend
situation_ru: Двое друзей договариваются о поездке на пляж.
script:
Kate: Hi, Josh! What are you doing this weekend?
Josh: Nothing much. Why?
Kate: The weather is going to be nice on Sunday. Do you want to go to the beach?
Josh: I'd love to, but I can't on Sunday. My parents are visiting. What about Saturday?
Kate: Saturday? Hmm, I have a dance class in the morning, but I'm free after twelve.
Josh: Great. Let's go in the afternoon, then. I can drive.
Kate: Perfect! I'll bring some sandwiches.
Josh: And I'll bring a ball. See you on Saturday!

questions.q: Why can't Josh go on Sunday?
options: He has to work all day on Sunday
The weather will be bad on Sunday
questions.explain_ru: В воскресенье к Джошу приезжают родители.

questions.q: When are they going to the beach?
questions.explain_ru: Утром у Кейт занятие, поэтому едут в субботу днём.

questions.q: What is Kate going to bring?
questions.explain_ru: I'll bring some sandwiches — мяч берёт Джош.

situation_en: Two friends make plans for a trip to the beach.

title: At the hotel
situation_ru: Гость заселяется в отель и уточняет детали.
script:
Receptionist: Good evening, welcome to the Harbor View Hotel. How can I help you?
Daniel: Hi, I have a reservation. My name's Daniel Ross.
Receptionist: Let me check. Yes, Mr. Ross, a double room for three nights.
Daniel: Actually, it should be four nights. I'm leaving on Friday morning.
Receptionist: Oh, I'm sorry about that. Let me fix it. OK, that's four nights now. Your room is 312, on the third floor. Breakfast is from seven to ten in the restaurant.
Daniel: Great. And is there Wi-Fi in the room?
Receptionist: Yes, it's free. The password is on the card with your key.
Daniel: Thanks. Oh, one more thing. Is there somewhere I can leave my bike?
Receptionist: Sure, there's a bike room next to the parking lot.
Daniel: Perfect, thank you. What time do I need to leave the room on Friday?
Receptionist: By eleven, please.

questions.q: What was the problem with Daniel's booking?
options: It had the wrong number of nights
His room wasn't ready when he arrived
There were no double rooms left
questions.explain_ru: В брони было три ночи вместо четырёх.

questions.q: Which floor is Daniel's room on?
questions.explain_ru: Номер 312 на третьем этаже.

questions.q: Where can Daniel leave his bike?
options: In his room on the third floor
questions.explain_ru: Велосипедная комната рядом с парковкой.

situation_en: A guest is checking in at a hotel.

topic_en: A guide at the start of a walking tour
title: The Old Town tour
situation_ru: Гид рассказывает группе туристов о плане экскурсии.
script: Sophie: OK, everyone, welcome to the Old Town walking tour. My name's Sophie, and I'll be your guide today. The tour takes about two hours, and we'll stop for a coffee break halfway, at a lovely little bakery near the river. [pause 1s] First, we're going to walk to the old market square. It's only five minutes from here. Then we'll visit the castle, but please remember that we can't go inside today because it's closed for repairs. [pause 1s] If you need the toilet, there are some at the tourist office, just behind me. And please stay together, because the streets are very busy on Saturdays. We'll finish at about one o'clock at the old bridge, where you can take some great photos of the river. Right, any questions? No? Then let's go!

questions.q: How long does the tour take?
questions.explain_ru: The tour takes about two hours.

questions.q: Why can't the group go inside the castle?
questions.explain_ru: Замок закрыт на ремонт.

questions.q: Where will the group have a coffee break?
options: At a bakery near the river
At the tourist office behind her
At a café inside the castle
questions.explain_ru: Перерыв на кофе в пекарне у реки.

situation_en: A tour guide tells a group of tourists about the plan for the tour.

topic_en: Friends talking about a climbing class
title: The first climbing class
script:
Maya: So, how was your first climbing class?
Leo: Honestly? I was really nervous before it started. Everyone looked so strong!
Maya: And?
Leo: Well, it was hard. My arms were shaking after twenty minutes. But the instructor was great. She was really patient, and she didn't laugh when I fell off the wall.
Maya: You fell off?
Leo: Only from about a meter! You wear a rope, so it's totally safe.
Maya: So are you going back?
Leo: Definitely. I've already booked five more classes.
Maya: Isn't it expensive?
Leo: Twenty-five dollars a class, so it's not cheap. But I think it's worth it. And I slept really well that night, too.
Maya: Maybe I'll come with you next time. I've always wanted to try it.
Leo: You should! The Tuesday class is for beginners.

questions.q: How did Leo feel before the class?
questions.explain_ru: Лео очень волновался: все казались такими сильными.

questions.q: What does Leo say about the instructor?
questions.explain_ru: Инструктор была терпеливой и не смеялась, когда он упал.

questions.q: What does Leo think about climbing now?
options: He enjoys it and wants to continue
It's too dangerous for someone like him
He'd prefer to find a different instructor
questions.explain_ru: Он уже записался ещё на пять занятий и считает, что они того стоят.

situation_en: Two friends talk about their first climbing class.

topic_en: Colleagues talking about a weekend trip
title: A weekend in Edinburgh
situation_ru: Коллега рассказывает о поездке в Эдинбург.
script:
Ben: Morning, Hannah! How was your weekend in Edinburgh?
Hannah: Oh, it was lovely, but the journey there was a bit of a disaster.
Ben: Really? What happened?
Hannah: Well, our train was cancelled, so we had to take a bus instead. It took nearly seven hours!
Ben: Seven hours? That's awful.
Hannah: I know. But the city was amazing. We walked up a hill on Saturday and saw the whole city, and on Sunday we went to a small museum about its history. And the food was fantastic.
Ben: Where did you stay?
Hannah: In a tiny flat near the station. It was cheap and really comfortable.
Ben: Did the weather stay nice?
Hannah: Not really. It rained on Sunday afternoon, so we spent hours in a bookshop. Actually, that was one of the best parts!
Ben: Sounds great. Would you go back?
Hannah: Definitely, but next time I'm flying.

questions.q: What went wrong with the journey to Edinburgh?
questions.explain_ru: Поезд отменили, и пришлось ехать на автобусе.

questions.q: What did Hannah do when it rained?
options: Watched a film at the cinema
questions.explain_ru: Когда пошёл дождь, они провели несколько часов в книжном.

questions.q: How will Hannah probably travel to Edinburgh next time?
questions.explain_ru: Next time I'm flying — значит, на самолёте.

situation_en: A colleague talks about a weekend trip to Edinburgh.
